findings.source_quote: παντὸς οὐδήποτε ἐντὸς ὅρων θεοσεβείας ὄντος καὶ μὴ βλασφημοῦντος αὐτοῦ τὸ ἅγιον πνεῦμα
findings.english_quote: whenever anyone at all is within the bounds of reverence for God and does not blaspheme his holy spirit
findings.issue: The main text substitutes the proposed positive οὑδήποτε for the supplied negative οὐδήποτε, changing the qualification from never being within the bounds of reverence to being within them. The note explicitly discloses this substitution, but disclosure does not make the positive wording faithful to the selected reading. Context motivates the proposed correction without establishing that the printed negative means its opposite. The print is already verified, and a negative construction admits defensible English; this therefore requires translation revision rather than further print verification.
findings.suggested_revision: Represent the supplied negative in the main text, for example by replacing this fragment with “in the case of anyone who is never within the bounds of reverence for God and does not blaspheme his holy spirit.” Explain the contextual difficulty in the note and retain οὑδήποτε only as a distinctly labeled proposed correction. This proposed revision requires fresh review.
